post.topic: Automated Lead Qualification and Routing for Marketing Agencies
post.headline: How AI Qualifies Agency Leads Before You Call
post.subline: Imagine every web form submission automatically scored, enriched, and routed directly to your sales team instantly.
post.caption:
Your agency gets inquiries daily, but how many actually fit your ideal client profile?

Manually checking prospect websites, qualifying budgets, and scheduling discovery calls burns hours of your team’s focus every week.

Here is a simple automation blueprint: An AI workflow intercepts form submissions, instantly checks prospect company data, scores the lead based on budget and service fit, and routes high-value prospects straight to your calendar. Lower-fit leads receive an automated, friendly resource guide.

No manual research. Zero delay for high-ticket leads.
